about: Defect class x platform coverage of the sanitizer lanes. Every cell is covered, partial (with why), or a named limit (with why). Validated by scripts/sanitizer-coverage-map.py map. Which functions each lane actually EXECUTES is the run/union/ratchet part of the same tool.

macos-arm64.why: use-after-return and use-after-scope only on the Homebrew-LLVM diag lane, which is local-only

windows-arm64.why: no ASan runtime for Windows ARM64; the class is covered for Windows by the x64 leg

linux-x64.why: test builds use the C runtime allocator: mimalloc bindings, the --wrap shims and the slab never run sanitized; mimalloc itself is built without ASan

macos-arm64.why: same as linux-x64; the zone-observer path runs only in the memwaste flavours

windows-arm64.why: no ASan runtime for Windows ARM64
trap mode: a violation stops the run without a message

linux-x64.venue: PR CI (on by default under ASan)

macos-arm64.venue: local (Homebrew LLVM; Apple clang refuses detect_leaks)

windows-x64.why: no leak sanitizer on Windows; the waste lane's live-per-site report at the last phase and the soak slope stand in

windows-arm64.why: no leak sanitizer on Windows; the waste lane's live-per-site report at the last phase and the soak slope stand in

linux-x64.why: CI only; deep-recursion suites need larger thread stacks under MSan

linux-arm64.why: locally red: three deep-recursion suites overflow their thread stacks

macos-arm64.why: no MSan on macOS; the access lane's read-before-write verdict on a real corpus is the second net, per block, not per byte

windows-x64.why: no MSan on Windows; the access lane (clang) is the second net

windows-arm64.why: no MSan on Windows; the access lane (clang) is the second net

linux-x64.why: a subset of suites runs under TSan

linux-arm64.why: a subset of suites runs under TSan

macos-arm64.why: a subset of suites runs under TSan

linux-x64.why: vendored trees are filtered out of cppcheck and the analyzer gate

windows-x64.why: static lanes are platform-independent source passes; Windows-only code is analysed by CodeQL only

windows-arm64.why: static lanes are platform-independent source passes

linux-x64.why: fixed MCP payloads in CI; libFuzzer targets for extractors, Cypher and config editors run in dry-run/nightly

macos-arm64.why: local only (Homebrew LLVM ships libFuzzer; Apple clang does not)

windows-x64.why: libFuzzer is not built for the MinGW toolchain

windows-arm64.why: libFuzzer is not built for the MinGW toolchain

windows-x64.why: the per-function scaling lane needs clang's profile runtime; whole-pipeline counters only

windows-arm64.why: the per-function scaling lane needs clang's profile runtime; whole-pipeline counters only

windows-x64.why: libc wrappers cover mem*/str* and FILE I/O only; the access lane needs a clang build

windows-arm64.why: libc wrappers cover mem*/str* and FILE I/O only

windows-x64.why: no system-call or pthread lock wrappers on Windows: Win32 file and lock APIs are imports --wrap cannot redirect

windows-arm64.why: no system-call or pthread lock wrappers on Windows: Win32 file and lock APIs are imports --wrap cannot redirect

linux-x64.why: needs a clang job; the gcc legs are not measured

windows-x64.why: no sanitizer lane on Windows executes under clang source coverage yet

windows-arm64.why: no sanitizer lane on Windows executes under clang source coverage yet
